body: Source: V1-1276 builder report and docs/build-log/2026-10-12-v1-1276-dogfood-producer-cem-1-0.md 'Limits and NOT_RUN' (PR beamfall/corvint#837, merge 9deae4838). Decision 0525: RC3 ships cem/1.0 only; V1-1278 removes the 0.x readers, so each surface below must read cem/1.0 before or with that removal. Observed with the V1-1276 binary: `corvint docs corpus cem` projects cem/0.x only and reports a cem/1.0 map as internal-error wrapping unsupported-spec; `cem report --ocm` reads cem/0.x only. Expected: a stable map is projected through a stable ACCEPT (the library route doccorpus.StableCEMProjection / `docs corpus cem-stable` exists from V1-0632 C13), or at minimum refused with a closed, actionable code, never internal-error.
title: docs corpus cem and cem report --ocm: read cem/1.0 maps (corpus currently reports internal-error)
